agency.name: Office of Substance Abuse and Mental Health (OSAMH), Arkansas Department of Human Services

narrNote: Arkansas does not appear on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, checked 2026-10-22). An 'Arkansas Alliance of Recovery Residences' describes itself as the state's NARR affiliate, but it is not in NARR's official directory — self-described only, so no affiliate is recorded.
notes: Agency is SAMHSA's Single State Agency for Arkansas (DHS Office of Substance Abuse and Mental Health); no main phone line is published on the OSAMH page (staff contacts are on DHS's Contact OSAMH page), so agency phone is null. COVERAGE CAVEAT for 211: Arkansas 211's operator changed in 2026 to Hark at Excellerate Foundation, and its own site states it is currently only able to serve Benton, Madison, and Washington counties (Northwest Arkansas) after operating statewide 2019-2025 — callers elsewhere in Arkansas may reach limited service; dial 2-1-1 / 866-489-6983 / text ZIP to 898211. The Arkansas Crisis Center (Bentonville) answers Arkansas's 988 calls statewide; its site now directs callers to 988 (its historic direct line was 1-888-274-7472). countyDirectory is null: the identified gateway is DHS OSAMH's official 'Find Substance Abuse or Mental Health Treatment' page (humanservices.arkansas.gov/.../office-of-substance-abuse-and-mental-health/samh-treatment/), whose indexed content lists SUD treatment directories, community mental health centers, and opioid treatment providers, but its direct fetch was blocked by a research-tool rate limit during this run — re-verification pending before publishing the URL. medicaidSud is null: Arkansas Medicaid behavioral-health/SUD coverage is administered through DHS (Division of Medical Services / OSAMH, incl. ARHOME and PASSE), but no single member-facing SUD coverage page was fetch-verified this run. Wolfe Street Foundation (Little Rock) is Arkansas's leading recovery community organization — peer recovery support and a recovery community center since 1982 — identified via its own site content in search results; its direct fetch was also rate-limited this run, so it is noted here rather than listed in peerOrgs pending re-verification.
